name: Shidou Mana
source:
Mana, a freshman at Shiromiya Academy and a fellow Esquire member with Kaname, hails from the influential Shido Group, a corporate giant.

While proud of her distinguished family, she's also aware of her own shortcomings as a Shidou. Her journey to knighthood is driven by a desire to grow and live up to her family's esteemed reputation. Beneath her kind and nurturing exterior lies a hint of timidity and self-doubt. Yet, she constantly endeavors to uphold her family's honor, often putting up a brave front.

While Mana doesn't excel in any one area, she's hardworking and meets expectations in her studies and sports through her relentless effort.

Her view of men is a bit unusual due to the influence of her family's maid, making her somewhat cautious and clean-conscious. Contrary to typical expectations of a young lady of her status, Mana is skilled in practical tasks like cooking, laundry, and cleaning. She's particularly good at cooking, almost at a professional level, thanks to learning from her family's chefs.

In addition to cooking, she also loves building detailed bottle ships, enjoying seeing small efforts come together. Mana has a taste for Western sweets but is not a fan of bitter things like black coffee or alcohol.

"It's not just about me; it's about the Shido family's status, which feels too grand for who I am right now."

[Translated and edited from [url=https://www.akabeesoft3.com/products/koikishi/chara.html/]the official site[/url].]
